name: Cecilia Gentili
excerpt: Cecilia’s parents were Italian and Argentinian. Cecilia was sexually abused by a neighbor throughout the childhood, beginning at age 6. Cecilia came out as gay at age 12 and started identifying as a woman in the early 20s, at age 26 deciding to move to the United States in search of a better life. After leaving Argentina, Cecilia lived in Brazil and later being banned from there, Cecilia never divulged why.

name: Judy Guzman
excerpt: Judy died from a drug overdose.

name: Chrystel Yager
excerpt: Chrystel was mother of a daughter. She was advertised for prostitution purposes on Backpage and charged with „promoting prostitution“ since 2015.

name: Leondra Foster
excerpt: Leondra was mother of a 16 year old. She was once in a relationship with Somorie Moses, but when she tried to leave, he threatened to kill her. Leondra was beaten to death by Moses who was her pimp. He decided to conceal her remains instead of contacting the police. The following morning, using a knife and a saw, Moses dismembered her body inside their shared apartment in Brooklyn, New York.

name: Melissa Barthelemy
place: Bronx, New York City, New York
excerpt: Melissa grew up in upstate New York, graduated in Buffalo and after school got her cosmetology license. At the age of 20 she left to live in the Bronx. She lived in a tiny apartment together with her five cats. She dreamed of having her own business and wanted to make money for this purpose.She advertised on Craigslist offering sexual service for money.

name: Colleen McNamee
excerpt: Colleen at school was known as a bubbly peacemaker in Sachem High School on Long Island, dressing impeccably. She could be heard in hallways imploring friends in a squeaky voice to stop fighting or sleeping in class. Colleen was reported missing by her parents one day after she was last seen. According to her mother, she was bipolar and struggling with a drug addiction and was in prostitution.

name: Carmen Vargas
excerpt: Carmen was last seen getting into a dark car with a man in Harlem. Carmens‘ remains would be found at the side of the road along the Meadowbrook State Parkway, in Freeport, weeks later on September 11. Her ankles and wrists were bound with a cord. A towel covered her face, a rope was tied around her neck, and she was missing three of her front teeth.

name: Marc Stevens
excerpt: Marc was born Mark Kuttner in Brooklyn in 1943. He was the third of four children born to first generation Jewish parents Walter and Hannah. He attended Midwood High School in Brooklyn. His name was later legally changed to Stevens. Marc appeared in over 80 pornographic movies; and lived next door to Annie Sprinkle. He was married to Jill Monroe and Miranda Stevens.
